archetype: Local-first desktop AI coworker that delivers finished work (not chat) — built on aisuite, with a Python agent server supervised by a Tauri shell

language_distribution.Test Python: 79 test files in tests/ + playwright e2e in surfaces/gui/e2e

backend: aisuite (pinned git commit, unified chat-completions + agents layer)
pdf: pypdfium2 (rasterization, BSD pdfium — explicitly NOT PyMuPDF/AGPL)

capabilities_marketed.deliverables: documents, spreadsheets, reports, web pages — produced as files
capabilities_marketed.channels: Slack mention @OpenWorker opens a desktop session; reply lands in thread
capabilities_marketed.integrations: 25+ connectors: GitHub, Slack, Jira, Notion, Linear, HubSpot, Outlook, monday.com, Gmail, Google Calendar, terminal, local files, MCP
capabilities_marketed.approval_gating: writes/sends/shell are approval-gated; unattended runs park asks in inbox
capabilities_marketed.byo_model: OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Inkling / GLM / DeepSeek / Kimi / Qwen / MiniMax / Mistral / Grok + Together/Fireworks (open-weight) + Ollama (local)

privacy_model: Local-first. Agent loop, conversations, tokens, model keys all in app's local secret store. Only cloud piece is a small service brokering OAuth handshakes for connectors.

test_suite.frontend_e2e_live: Playwright live (surfaces/gui/e2e-live — real server + persona fixtures)

git_summary.last_commit: 2026-07-24 (4766e59 Keep ripgrep searches out of generated directories)
git_summary.provenance: Originally developed inside the aisuite repository; moved to its own repo in the initial import commit (2b45018)
